Wood.description: Gathered with a pocketknife or chopped with an axe. Goes into sticks, axes, quarries and mining drills, and can be stored in a bucket of wood.

Stone.summary: Rock for heavier tools and machines.
Stone.description: Gathered with a pocketknife or mined with a quarry. Goes into stone axes, quarries and mining drills, and can be stored in a bucket of stone.

Iron.description: Gathered with a pocketknife, which takes the most work of any resource, or drilled with a mining drill. Goes into iron axes, buckets and mining drills.

Stick.description: Made by splitting wood. Two sticks and a piece of wood make a wood axe.

BucketOfWood.summary: Holds any amount of wood in one item.
BucketOfWood.description: Keeps your inventory short. Full buckets are spent to level up quarries and mining drills.

BucketOfStone.summary: Holds any amount of stone in one item.
BucketOfStone.description: Keeps your inventory short. Full buckets are spent to level up quarries and mining drills.

BucketOfIron.summary: Holds any amount of iron in one item.
BucketOfIron.description: Keeps your inventory short. Full buckets are spent to level up mining drills.

Pocketknife.description: Made from nothing. You need one to gather wood, stone and iron, and gathering gives it back, so one lasts forever.

WoodAxe.description: Starts with 100 durability and loses 1 per use; at 0 it can no longer be used. Can be upgraded to a stone axe.

StoneAxe.description: Made by upgrading a wood axe, keeping its durability. Loses 1 durability per use. Can be upgraded to an iron axe.

IronAxe.description: Made by upgrading a stone axe, keeping its durability. Loses 1 durability per use.

Quarry.description: Makes one more stone per use than its level, up to level 6. Level it up with full buckets of wood and stone.

MiningDrill.description: Spends 5 wood per use and makes one more iron than its level, up to level 6. Level it up with full buckets of wood, stone and iron.

Bit.description: Made from wood, stone or iron. No recipe uses bits yet.

CraftPocketknife.description: Your first tool. It takes no materials, and you need it to gather wood, stone and iron.

GatherWood.description: Your computer does a little work first. The pocketknife comes back with a fresh key, ready to use again.

GatherStone.description: Your computer does a moderate amount of work first. The pocketknife comes back with a fresh key, ready to use again.

GatherIron.description: Your computer does a lot of work first. The pocketknife comes back with a fresh key, ready to use again.

CraftBucketOfWood.summary: Make an empty bucket for wood from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfWood.description: A bucket holds any amount of wood in one item. Fill it with the Add actions.

CraftBucketOfStone.summary: Make an empty bucket for stone from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfStone.description: A bucket holds any amount of stone in one item. Fill it with the Add actions.

CraftBucketOfIron.summary: Make an empty bucket for iron from 1 iron.
CraftBucketOfIron.description: A bucket holds any amount of iron in one item. Fill it with the Add actions.

BucketOfWoodAdd1.description: Spends 1 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodAdd5.description: Spends 5 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodAdd10.description: Spends 10 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodAdd50.description: Spends 50 wood and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfWoodTake1.summary: Take 1 wood out of a bucket.
BucketOfWoodTake1.description: Lowers the bucket's count by 1 and gives you 1 wood. The bucket must hold at least that many.

BucketOfStoneAdd1.description: Spends 1 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneAdd5.description: Spends 5 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneAdd10.description: Spends 10 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneAdd50.description: Spends 50 stone and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfStoneTake1.summary: Take 1 stone out of a bucket.
BucketOfStoneTake1.description: Lowers the bucket's count by 1 and gives you 1 stone. The bucket must hold at least that many.

BucketOfIronAdd1.description: Spends 1 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronAdd5.description: Spends 5 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronAdd10.description: Spends 10 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronAdd50.description: Spends 50 iron and adds them to the bucket's count.

BucketOfIronTake1.summary: Take 1 iron out of a bucket.
BucketOfIronTake1.description: Lowers the bucket's count by 1 and gives you 1 iron. The bucket must hold at least that many.

CraftWoodAxe.summary: Make a wood axe from 1 wood and 2 sticks.
CraftWoodAxe.description: A new axe has 100 durability and loses 1 per use. It chops 2 wood per use.

CraftStoneAxe.summary: Upgrade your wood axe with 1 stone.
CraftStoneAxe.description: Uses up the old axe and keeps its remaining durability. The stone axe chops 3 wood per use.

CraftIronAxe.summary: Upgrade your stone axe with 1 iron.
CraftIronAxe.description: Uses up the old axe and keeps its remaining durability. The iron axe chops 4 wood per use.

UseWoodAxe.summary: Chop 2 wood with your wood axe.
UseWoodAxe.description: Takes 1 durability; an axe at 0 can no longer be used. Your computer does a little work first.

UseStoneAxe.summary: Chop 3 wood with your stone axe.
UseStoneAxe.description: Takes 1 durability; an axe at 0 can no longer be used. Your computer does a little work first.

UseIronAxe.summary: Chop 4 wood with your iron axe.
UseIronAxe.description: Takes 1 durability; an axe at 0 can no longer be used. Your computer does a little work first.

UseQuarry1.summary: Mine 2 stone with a level 1 quarry.
UseQuarry1.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 1. Your computer does some work first.

UseMiningDrill1.summary: Drill 2 iron from 5 wood with a level 1 mining drill.
UseMiningDrill1.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 1. Your computer does a lot of work first.

UseQuarry2.summary: Mine 3 stone with a level 2 quarry.
UseQuarry2.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 2. Your computer does some work first.

UseMiningDrill2.summary: Drill 3 iron from 5 wood with a level 2 mining drill.
UseMiningDrill2.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 2. Your computer does a lot of work first.

UseQuarry3.summary: Mine 4 stone with a level 3 quarry.
UseQuarry3.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 3. Your computer does some work first.

UseMiningDrill3.summary: Drill 4 iron from 5 wood with a level 3 mining drill.
UseMiningDrill3.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 3. Your computer does a lot of work first.

UseQuarry4.summary: Mine 5 stone with a level 4 quarry.
UseQuarry4.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 4. Your computer does some work first.

UseMiningDrill4.summary: Drill 5 iron from 5 wood with a level 4 mining drill.
UseMiningDrill4.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 4. Your computer does a lot of work first.

UseQuarry5.summary: Mine 6 stone with a level 5 quarry.
UseQuarry5.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 5. Your computer does some work first.

UseMiningDrill5.summary: Drill 6 iron from 5 wood with a level 5 mining drill.
UseMiningDrill5.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 5. Your computer does a lot of work first.

UseQuarry6.summary: Mine 7 stone with a level 6 quarry.
UseQuarry6.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 6. Your computer does some work first.

UseMiningDrill6.summary: Drill 7 iron from 5 wood with a level 6 mining drill.
UseMiningDrill6.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 6. Your computer does a lot of work first.

BuildQuarry.summary: Build a level 1 quarry from 20 wood and 10 stone.
BuildQuarry.description: Quarries mine stone without wearing out, and make more at higher levels.

BuildMiningDrill.summary: Build a level 1 mining drill from 10 wood, 50 stone and 5 iron.
BuildMiningDrill.description: Mining drills turn wood into iron without wearing out, and make more at higher levels.

LevelUpQuarry1.summary: Raise a level 1 quarry to level 2.
LevelUpQuarry1.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 1. Spends a bucket holding exactly 40 wood and a bucket holding exactly 20 stone.

LevelUpMiningDrill1.summary: Raise a level 1 mining drill to level 2.
LevelUpMiningDrill1.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 1. Spends buckets holding exactly 20 wood, 100 stone and 10 iron.

LevelUpQuarry2.summary: Raise a level 2 quarry to level 3.
LevelUpQuarry2.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 2. Spends a bucket holding exactly 80 wood and a bucket holding exactly 40 stone.

LevelUpMiningDrill2.summary: Raise a level 2 mining drill to level 3.
LevelUpMiningDrill2.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 2. Spends buckets holding exactly 40 wood, 200 stone and 20 iron.

LevelUpQuarry3.summary: Raise a level 3 quarry to level 4.
LevelUpQuarry3.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 3. Spends a bucket holding exactly 160 wood and a bucket holding exactly 80 stone.

LevelUpMiningDrill3.summary: Raise a level 3 mining drill to level 4.
LevelUpMiningDrill3.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 3. Spends buckets holding exactly 80 wood, 400 stone and 40 iron.

LevelUpQuarry4.summary: Raise a level 4 quarry to level 5.
LevelUpQuarry4.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 4. Spends a bucket holding exactly 320 wood and a bucket holding exactly 160 stone.

LevelUpMiningDrill4.summary: Raise a level 4 mining drill to level 5.
LevelUpMiningDrill4.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 4. Spends buckets holding exactly 160 wood, 800 stone and 80 iron.

LevelUpQuarry5.summary: Raise a level 5 quarry to level 6.
LevelUpQuarry5.description: Only works on a quarry at exactly level 5. Spends a bucket holding exactly 640 wood and a bucket holding exactly 320 stone.

LevelUpMiningDrill5.summary: Raise a level 5 mining drill to level 6.
LevelUpMiningDrill5.description: Only works on a mining drill at exactly level 5. Spends buckets holding exactly 320 wood, 1600 stone and 160 iron.

BitsFromWood.description: Takes a short, fixed amount of computing time.

BitsFromStone.description: Takes a short, fixed amount of computing time.

BitsFromIron.description: Takes a short, fixed amount of computing time.

RekeyWood.summary: Give a wood a fresh key.
RekeyWood.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyStone.summary: Give a stone a fresh key.
RekeyStone.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyIron.summary: Give a iron a fresh key.
RekeyIron.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyStick.summary: Give a stick a fresh key.
RekeyStick.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyBucketOfWood.summary: Give a bucket of wood a fresh key.
RekeyBucketOfWood.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyBucketOfStone.summary: Give a bucket of stone a fresh key.
RekeyBucketOfStone.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyBucketOfIron.summary: Give a bucket of iron a fresh key.
RekeyBucketOfIron.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyPocketknife.summary: Give a pocketknife a fresh key.
RekeyPocketknife.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyWoodAxe.summary: Give a wood axe a fresh key.
RekeyWoodAxe.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyStoneAxe.summary: Give a stone axe a fresh key.
RekeyStoneAxe.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyIronAxe.summary: Give a iron axe a fresh key.
RekeyIronAxe.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyQuarry.summary: Give a quarry a fresh key.
RekeyQuarry.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyMiningDrill.summary: Give a mining drill a fresh key.
RekeyMiningDrill.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.

RekeyBit.summary: Give a bit a fresh key.
RekeyBit.description: Changes nothing else about it. You won't need this for crafting.
